column8: The exact timezone name and offset remain present while a TableScan-plus-Selection list DAG is encoded, including condition protobufs and output offsets. Full SQL execution, system-location discovery, named-IANA loading, CheckSelectRequestHook behavior, and arbitrary executor trees remain external.

The bounded TiKV list form is exactly TableScan then Selection, with Selection.child absent and stable executor IDs. General tree flattening, TiFlash child ownership, joins, aggregates, limits, TopN, exchanges, and every other executor shape remain external.
